interpret: Frame bounded scientific questions about sampling, spectral and time-local structure in the declared validation band. Also ask whether selected raw windows contain contiguous high-amplitude excursions and, when an exact prior trained model is available, whether its predictions preserve or suppress such structure. Do not invent earlier model failures at cold start.
analysis: Use measured evidence within the declared selection. Quantify the frequency and duration of contiguous high-amplitude excursions only if scientifically useful; choose and disclose a robust threshold and coverage. Prefer existing skills when they answer a question cleanly. If they do not, a bounded experiment-local analysis is appropriate. A generated program is not evidence until its execution result is certified. Compare a prior model only when its exact certified artifact and separately authorized inputs are available.
propose: Distinguish observations measured on our data from external literature claims and from hypotheses. When Data Analysis evidence is present, use its quantitative findings and limitations explicitly; when absent, do not imply that an analysis was performed.
